items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: I know Hungry could use it, because from what I can understand, he was in bad shape.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. He came down here, and he was sick. He went to Charity Hospital, and he came out of Charity Hospital, and he went on back to New York. Even his brother didn't know how to find him. So I'm going to ask Mr. Crump, too. Did they find Hungry? I'm going to ask him that tomorrow. Because they had some money. You know, from this, it's like a rug, it's from this theater thing that you get every so often. And it was about $400, $500.
